articles.title: Congo Races to Protect Health Workers as Ebola Outbreak Grows
articles.summary: Congo started giving Ebola vaccines to health workers in Bunia on Saturday. This outbreak is the country's deadliest ever, with 7,541 cases and 3,639 deaths. The vaccine, called Ervebo, was made for a different type of Ebola, so scientists are still testing how well it works here.

articles.title: US and Denmark Reach Deal on Greenland After Trump's Threats
articles.summary: The US and Denmark announced a deal on Greenland's security on Saturday, after President Trump spent months threatening to take the island by force. The deal gives the US a say in Greenland's security, but Denmark keeps sovereignty. Leaders expect to sign it next week.

articles.title: Trump Wants an 'AI Force' — and a Special AI Boss
articles.summary: President Trump says the U.S. will start an 'AI Force' and pick an AI tsar (a top boss for AI). He posted this on Saturday and says AI could grow to 25% of America's economy.
